title: Chlorogenic acid (CGA) exerts antidepressant-like effects by regulating SIRT1/FoxO3a/PINK1/Parkin pathway in LPS-induced depressive mice.
authors: Piao, Xinmiao; Song, Jinfang; Piao, Jingjing; Shang, Yuhan; Jin, Yang; Cui, Ranji; Li, Bingjin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究绿原酸通过SIRT1/FoxO3a/PINK1/Parkin通路在LPS诱导抑郁小鼠中发挥抗抑郁作用，属于纯生物学机制与湿实验研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: A growing focus in nutritional psychiatry is examining dietary interventions as a therapeutic strategy for depression. Chlorogenic acid (CGA), a naturally occurring polyphenol, has demonstrated promising anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective effects. This study aimed to elucidate the underlying molecular targets and mechanisms responsible for CGA's antidepressant-like actions. The potential targets and pathways of CGA related to FoxO3a were initially predicted using network pharmacology and molecular docking. In vitro, the protective effects of CGA were investigated in H(2)O(2)-stimulated HT-22 cells by assessing cell viability, reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels, mitochondrial membrane potential, and the expression of mitophagy-related proteins. In vivo, a depression model was established in male mice via intraperitoneal injection of lipopolysaccharide (LPS). The antidepressant efficacy of CGA was evaluated through a behavioral test battery. Microglial activation was detected via immunofluorescence. Furthermore, mitochondrial ultrastructure was examined by transmission electron microscopy (TEM), and the expression of mitophagy-related proteins was additionally validated by Western blotting. Finally, the direct interaction between SIRT1 and FoxO3a was examined by co-immunoprecipitation. In vitro, CGA pretreatment improved HT-22 cells viability under H(2)O(2)-induced oxidative stress, reduced ROS levels, and restored mitochondrial membrane potential. In vivo, CGA reduced neuroinflammation by lowering the levels of proinflammatory cytokines interleukin-1beta (IL-1beta), interleukin-6 (IL-6), and tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha), inhibited microglial activation, and alleviated depressive-like behaviors in LPS-treated mice. Additionally, CGA activated the sirtuin 1 (SIRT1) / forkhead box O3a (FoxO3a) / PTEN-induced kinase 1 (PINK1) / Parkin signaling pathway, promoting hippocampal mitophagy. The antidepressant-like effects of CGA were suppressed upon SIRT1 antagonism with EX527. This study suggests that CGA may serve as a potential therapeutic agent for depression.
abstract_zh: 营养精神病学中一个日益受到关注的领域是研究饮食干预作为抑郁症的治疗策略。绿原酸（CGA）作为一种天然存在的多酚，已显示出有前景的抗炎和神经保护作用。本研究旨在阐明CGA抗抑郁样作用背后的分子靶点和机制。通过网络药理学和分子对接，初步预测了CGA与FoxO3a相关的潜在靶点和通路。在体外实验中，通过评估细胞活力、活性氧（ROS）水平、线粒体膜电位以及线粒体自噬相关蛋白的表达，研究了CGA在H(2)O(2)刺激的HT-22细胞中的保护作用。在体内实验中，通过腹腔注射脂多糖（LPS）建立了雄性小鼠的抑郁模型。通过行为测试组评估了CGA的抗抑郁功效。通过免疫荧光检测了小胶质细胞活化。此外，通过透射电子显微镜（TEM）检查了线粒体超微结构，并通过Western blotting进一步验证了线粒体自噬相关蛋白的表达。最后，通过免疫共沉淀检测了SIRT1与FoxO3a之间的直接相互作用。在体外，CGA预处理改善了H(2)O(2)诱导氧化应激下HT-22细胞的活力，降低了ROS水平，并恢复了线粒体膜电位。在体内，CGA通过降低促炎细胞因子白细胞介素-1β（IL-1β）、白细胞介素-6（IL-6）和肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-α）的水平减少了神经炎症，抑制了小胶质细胞活化，并缓解了LPS处理小鼠的抑郁样行为。此外，CGA激活了sirtuin 1（SIRT1）/叉头框O3a（FoxO3a）/PTEN诱导激酶1（PINK1）/Parkin信号通路，促进了海马线粒体自噬。当SIRT1被EX527拮抗时，CGA的抗抑郁样作用被抑制。本研究提示，CGA可能作为抑郁症的潜在治疗药物。
